summary: Follow-up 8-K reports that the August 16, 2025 ransomware incident was untargeted and originated from a vulnerability in a third-party firewall service provider; affected systems are restored, the incident is fully contained and remediated, all operations are back, and no revenue appears lost. Estimated remediation, restoration and investigation costs of about $388,000 in Q3 2025 will likely be material to results and financial condition.
new_vs_prior: New relative to the August 21, 2025 8-K: (1) root cause identified as an untargeted exploitation of a vulnerability in a commercially available third-party firewall service provider; (2) affected systems restored and incident completely contained and remediated, with all disrupted functions fully operational (prior filing had only partial restoration and no timeline); (3) no revenue appears to have been lost; (4) a specific cost estimate of approximately $388,000 for Q3 2025, which the Company says will likely be material (prior filing said costs were 'reasonably likely' material with no figure); (5) the Company states that based on the findings no additional actions are necessary (the prior filing had contemplated notifying affected individuals and regulators depending on findings); this filing does not say whether any data was taken.
